mainEntity.name: Can I provide my own floor plans or must I use Zen Tiny Homes' designs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You are welcome to provide your own floor plans, sketches, or even just ideas as a starting point for your custom tiny home design. We specialize in bringing unique visions to life and view your input as a valuable foundation. Our design team will collaborate with you to refine your concepts, ensure structural integrity, optimize space, and confirm compliance with building codes and regulations. Whether you have a detailed plan or just an inspiration board, we integrate your preferences into the final design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can provide your own floor plans or ideas; we integrate your input into the custom design process while ensuring structural integrity and code compliance.
